title: 🎓 School & Education (школа и образование) & First Conditional + Future Time Clauses
description: Учим лексику о школе, экзаменах, дисциплине, системах образования в UK и US, а также условные предложения первого типа и придаточные времени. Уровень B1. 7 дней.

days.title: Day 1: School System in the UK
days.description: Знакомимся с типами школ и ключевыми словами о британской системе образования

grammar.title: School Vocabulary (UK)
grammar.rule: 📘 В Великобритании дети идут в начальную школу (primary school) в 5 лет. До этого некоторые посещают nursery school (с 2–4 лет), но это не обязательно. С 11 до 18 лет — secondary school. Большинство школ — государственные (state schools), финансируются правительством, обучение бесплатное. Около 10% — частные (private schools), где родители платят. Некоторые из них — школы-пансионы (boarding schools), где дети живут и учатся. Учеников начальной школы часто называют pupils, а средней и университета — students. Руководитель школы — head teacher. Учебный год делится на три terms (семестра). Чтобы поступить в университет, нужно сдать экзамены A-levels. Выпускник университета с degree называется graduate.

vocabulary.example: Many children go to nursery before primary school.
vocabulary.context_example: Многие дети ходят в детский сад перед начальной школой.

exercises.explanation: Primary school starts at age 5 in the UK.

exercises.explanation: State schools are funded by the government and free.

exercises.explanation: The head teacher is the principal.

exercises.explanation: In the UK, it's divided into three terms, not two semesters.

exercises.question: What do you call a person who has finished university with a degree?
exercises.explanation: A graduate is someone who has completed a university degree.

days.title: Day 2: School System in the US
days.description: Изучаем американскую систему образования и связанную лексику

grammar.title: School Vocabulary (US)
grammar.rule: 📘 В США система образования делится на три уровня: elementary school (начальная), middle school (или junior high school), и high school (старшая). Ученики делятся по возрастным группам на grades (классы). Самые маленькие начинают с kindergarten (детский сад), затем first grade и так до twelfth grade (последний класс старшей школы). Учебный год обычно делится на два semesters. Высшее образование в США часто называют college (колледж), хотя это может быть и университет.

Middle school is between elementary and high school.

vocabulary.example: High school is the final stage of secondary education.
vocabulary.context_example: Старшая школа — последний этап среднего образования.

vocabulary.example: Children start kindergarten at age 5.
vocabulary.context_example: Дети идут в детский сад в 5 лет.

vocabulary.example: She is in the fifth grade.

vocabulary.context_example: Учебный год состоит из двух семестров.

vocabulary.example: Many students go to college after high school.
vocabulary.context_example: Многие студенты идут в колледж после школы.

exercises.explanation: High school ends with twelfth grade.

exercises.explanation: The academic year has two semesters.

exercises.explanation: In the US, 'college' often refers to higher education institutions, but it's not exactly the same as university, though they are used interchangeably.

exercises.question: Which term is used for the middle school level?
exercises.explanation: Middle school is also called junior high school.

days.title: Day 3: Grammar — First Conditional
days.description: Изучаем условные предложения первого типа (if + present, will/won't)

grammar.title: First Conditional
grammar.rule:
📘 First conditional используется для описания возможной или вероятной ситуации в будущем и её последствий.

Формула: if + present simple, will/won't + infinitive

📌 Примеры:
✅ If you work hard, you'll pass your exams.
✅ The teacher won't be pleased if we're late.
✅ If you don't study, you won't get good grades.

⚠️ Важно: после if мы используем present simple (НЕ будущее время).
❌ If you will work hard, you'll pass. (неправильно)
✅ If you work hard, you'll pass. (правильно)

Мы также можем использовать unless (if...not):
✅ Alison won't get into university unless she gets good grades.

Мы можем использовать повелительное наклонение вместо will-части:
✅ If you have time, come and see us next week.
examples: If I fail my exams, I'll take them again next year.
If you give in your homework late, the teacher won't mark it.
Don't write anything unless you are sure of the answer.

vocabulary.example: I won't go unless you go too.
vocabulary.context_example: Я не пойду, если ты не пойдёшь.

vocabulary.example: You should revise before the test.

exercises.explanation: First conditional: if + present, will + infinitive.

exercises.explanation: Negative first conditional: won't + infinitive.

exercises.correct: If you work hard, you'll pass all your exams.

exercises.explanation: After 'if' we use present simple, not 'will'.

exercises.explanation: Unless = if not.

days.title: Day 4: Grammar — Future Time Clauses (when, until, as soon as, etc.)
days.description: Учим придаточные времени с when, until, as soon as, before, after

grammar.title: Future Time Clauses
grammar.rule:
📘 Для выражения будущего времени в придаточных предложениях времени мы используем present simple (НЕ будущее время) после союзов: when, until, as soon as, before, after.

📌 Структура: главное предложение (future) + придаточное (present simple).

✅ We'll have dinner when your father gets home.
✅ As soon as you get your exam results, call me.
✅ I won't go to bed until you come home.
✅ I'll have a quick lunch before I leave.
✅ After I finish university, I'll probably take a year off.

⚠️ Важно: в придаточных времени мы НЕ используем will.
❌ I'll call you when I will arrive. (неправильно)
✅ I'll call you when I arrive. (правильно)
examples: Don't turn over the exam paper until the teacher tells you to.
Please check the water's not too hot before the kids get in the bath.
Your parents will be really happy when they hear your good news.

vocabulary.example: Wait until I come back.
Call me as soon as you arrive.
Finish your homework before you go out.
vocabulary.context_example: Закончи домашнюю работу, перед тем как выйти.

vocabulary.example: I'll call you after I finish.
vocabulary.context_example: Я позвоню тебе после того, как закончу.

exercises.question: I won't go to bed ___ you come home.
exercises.explanation: We use 'until' to mean 'up to the moment when'.

exercises.question: Please check the water's not too hot ___ the kids get in the bath.
exercises.explanation: We use 'before' for an action that happens earlier.

exercises.question: Your parents will be really happy ___ they hear your good news.
exercises.explanation: We use 'when' to mean 'at the time that'.

exercises.question: I'll call you when I will arrive.
exercises.correct: I'll call you when I arrive.
accept: I'll call you when I arrive.
I'll call you when I arrive
exercises.explanation: After 'when' we use present simple, not future.

exercises.question: ___ (After / Before) I finish university, I'll probably take a year off.
exercises.explanation: We use 'after' to indicate a later time.

days.title: Day 5: Discipline and Exams — Vocabulary Practice
days.description: Учим глаголы и выражения о дисциплине, поведении, экзаменах

grammar.title: Discipline and Exams — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 Важные глаголы и выражения:

**Дисциплина:**
✅ be allowed to — иметь разрешение (We aren't allowed to take phones.)
✅ let (someone do) — позволять (They don't let us bring unhealthy food.)
✅ make (someone do) — заставлять (The teacher made me do extra homework.)
✅ misbehave — плохо себя вести
✅ be punished — быть наказанным
✅ be expelled — быть исключённым
✅ cheat — списывать, жульничать

**Экзамены:**
✅ take an exam — сдавать экзамен
✅ pass — сдать
✅ fail — провалить
✅ revise — повторять материал
✅ result — результат

They let us play games.
vocabulary.context_example: Они позволяют нам играть в игры.

vocabulary.context_example: Учитель заставил меня остаться после уроков.

vocabulary.example: If you misbehave, you'll be punished.
vocabulary.context_example: Если будешь плохо себя вести, будешь наказан.

vocabulary.example: The teacher will punish us if we're late.
vocabulary.context_example: Учитель накажет нас, если мы опоздаем.

vocabulary.example: Cheating can lead to being expelled.
Don't cheat in exams.
I need to revise for the test.
I hope I pass.
I might fail if I don't revise.

exercises.explanation: We use 'be allowed to' in negative form.

exercises.question: If you misbehave, you'll ___ (be punished / be expelled).
exercises.explanation: Misbehaving usually leads to punishment, not expulsion for minor cases.

exercises.explanation: Cheating is serious and can lead to expulsion.

exercises.explanation: 'Make' means to force someone to do something.

exercises.question: I won't get the ___ until July.
exercises.explanation: We say 'get the result' (результат экзамена).

days.title: Day 6: Reading — A Strict School
days.description: Читаем текст о строгой школе и отвечаем на вопросы

grammar.title: Reading Comprehension
grammar.rule: 📚 Прочитайте текст о строгой школе. Обратите внимание на лексику дисциплины, экзаменов и условные предложения. Затем ответьте на вопросы.

exercises.question: What are students not allowed to bring to school?
exercises.explanation: The text says: 'We aren't allowed to take our phones to school.'
exercises.readingText:
📖 A STRICT SCHOOL

Discipline is very strict in our school. We aren't allowed to take our phones to school, and they don't let us bring unhealthy food for lunch, like crisps or fizzy drinks. Most children behave well, but if you misbehave, for example, talk too much in class, you'll be punished and the teacher will probably make you stay behind after class. If you do something more serious, like cheat in an exam, you might even be expelled.

We have to take important exams at the end of the year. Students usually revise a lot. If you don't revise, you might fail. But if you work hard, you'll pass. The results come out in July, and if you pass, you get a certificate. If you fail, you can retake the exam in September.
